issue_request: FHIR-43667 was an Applied/Persuasive technical correction reporting that Questionnaire invariant que-1a referenced %resource.status='complete', which is not a Questionnaire status and should be %resource.status='active'.
initial_application: FHIR-32525 introduced the split que-1a/que-1b/que-1c constraints and the original complete status test. FHIR-43667 was applied by git commit 5fa59a80deca6414b4dbd79a5a21941c537e1a13, corresponding to Jira's 'Git 41c537e1a13' comment, changing the que-1a human text and expression to active.
additional_context: Questionnaire is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini. The only remaining exact %resource.status='complete' expressions are in tools/history/release4b and tools/history/release5 published-release profile bundles used for history/version-diff context, not in the current Questionnaire source. Corrected Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative current source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml already has %resource.status='active' for que-1a, and editing archived R4B/R5 release bundles would not be a current-spec correction.
